history.overview: The Sanctum is the arcane and strategic center of the Citadel Complex.

timeline.name: Sanctum Construction
timeline.description: Arcane halls and ritual chambers were built to support Muramite operations.

timeline.name: Ward Network Installation
timeline.description: Discord wards and conduits were installed throughout the Sanctum.

timeline.name: War Council Formation
timeline.description: Muramite officers established strategic planning halls.

timeline.name: Ritual Intensification
timeline.description: Discord rituals intensified, saturating the Sanctum with arcane energy.
